PRIVACY POLICY

Clear about the data we use.

Effective date: 5 October 2026

1. Who we are

Stech Digital is a website-first creative agency providing website design, development and social-content services. Our website is stechdigital.online, and privacy questions can be sent to hi@stechdigital.online.

2. Information we collect

When you contact us, we receive the information you choose to provide, such as your name, email address, business details and project requirements. With your consent, Google Analytics may also collect limited technical and usage information, such as approximate location, device type, browser, pages viewed and referral source.

3. How we use information

  • To respond to enquiries and discuss potential projects.
  • To deliver and support agreed services.
  • To understand and improve website performance.
  • To protect our website, communications and business operations.
  • To meet applicable legal obligations.

4. Analytics and cookies

We use Google Analytics 4 to understand aggregate website activity. Analytics storage is disabled until you accept analytics cookies through our consent notice. You may decline analytics or reopen Cookie settings from the website footer. Google may process analytics information under its own privacy terms.

5. Sharing and service providers

We do not sell personal information. Information may be handled by service providers that support our website, email, analytics and project delivery, or disclosed when required by law. Project-enquiry forms are processed by FormSubmit so the information you enter can be delivered to our business email. FormSubmit may temporarily retain submissions under its own terms. These providers process information under their respective terms and safeguards.

6. Retention and security

We retain enquiry and project information only for as long as reasonably necessary for communication, service delivery, record keeping and legal requirements. We use reasonable technical and organisational safeguards, but no internet transmission or storage system is completely secure.

7. Your choices

You may request access, correction or deletion of personal information you have provided, subject to applicable legal and contractual requirements. You may also decline analytics cookies at any time. Contact hi@stechdigital.online for assistance.

8. External links

Our website may link to third-party websites and social platforms. Their privacy practices are governed by their own policies, and Stech Digital is not responsible for their content or data handling.

9. Updates

We may update this policy as our services, tools or legal obligations change. The effective date shown above indicates the latest published version.
